text:
zoe: Quick consolidation from yesterday's postmortem — pulling out concrete follow-ups so we can close the loop. Please react with ✅ and claim ownership where relevant.

zoe: Root causes recap: routing flap -> delayed backups -> restore runbook gaps. Recurring pattern: short BGP blips turn into longer outages when TTLs and restore steps both slip.

zoe: Action items (high level):
- ownership: backups / routing / runbook / alerts
- timelines: quick wins (<=1w), medium (2w), docs/automation (4w)
- game-day: 1 dry-run + 1 full failover rehearsal

maria: I can own backups + restore verification. Plan: add incremental restore smoke test + daily snapshot validation. Target: quick win by Mon (2026-04-06). I'll open tickets.

ajay: I'll take routing fallback and BGP controls. Task: add circuit-level guardrails and a faster fallback route. Also will scope a small automation to lower DNS TTL on failover. Target EOW.

liam: I'll update the restore runbook with explicit KV cache invalidation steps and a checklist for partial restores. Will add a separate appendix for regional data ordering. Will submit PR and link it here.

sam: Can I own synthetic alerts for restore lag and routing divergence? I can add Grafana panels + alert rules.

zoe: Perfect. Owners: backups=maria, routing=ajay, runbook=liam, alerts=sam.

maria: quick note — backups ticket created: https://ourboard/BOARD-432. I'll attach test logs and a small shell snippet for the smoke test:

```
# run restore smoke test
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/latest/test-key /tmp/test-key && cat /tmp/test-key | head
```

ajay: FYI, routing script prototype is here: https://git/repo/fast-failover. Need review from eng-infra.

liam: PR opened: https://git/repo/restore-runbook/pull/58 — added step-by-step for KV warming and a rollback checklist. Comments welcome.

incident-bot: Created task INC-2026-88: "DR follow-up owners sync" and scheduled a sync on 2026-04-09T17:00Z.

zoe: Proposal for game-day: dry-run 2026-04-08 (control-plane only), full rehearsal 2026-04-15. Who's available?

maria: I can do 04-08 dry-run.

ajay: 04-08 lowish availability but can join the dry-run prep. 04-15 full rehearsal ok.

sam: available both dates. I'll make sure alerts are green.

liam: 04-15 ok. I'll be on call for runbook ops.

zoe: Great — I'll update the calendar invite and drop the final agenda by EOD.

zoe: Quick follow-up check: everyone, confirm scope and timeline (reply with owner + ETA). I'll mark items in the action tracker after confirmations.

maria: backups — ETA 2026-04-06 (quick win) / full automation by 2026-04-30. ✅

ajay: routing — ETA prototype EOW / guardrails by 2026-04-12. ✅

liam: runbook — PR open, expect merge by 2026-04-05 and docs by 2026-04-12. ✅

sam: alerts — panels + rules done by 2026-04-07. ✅

zoe: Thanks all. I'll close this thread after I populate the tracker and tag owners. If anything slips, bump here and we'll escalate to the DR rota. :thumbsup:
